rule_level_problems.rule: Urgent: joint symptoms with danger signs
rule_level_problems.problem: Gout urgent branch restates raw criteria rather than using an Acute gout probable diagnosis; also lacks surgery/injection exclusion. Urgent branch for septic arthritis/fracture uses active_condition which depends on the probable diagnoses (fine) but the 'no surgery/injection' omission lets gout path fire wrongly.

Rule is an or of two different page contexts: the red-box known-gout path (urgent) and the flowchart 'any sudden onset of 1-3 warm, extremely painful, red, swollen joints' path. Merging them means the non-urgent flowchart path also feeds nothing different, and the 1-3 joints count is lost. The flowchart path also does not exclude 'sprain' branch ordering: it requires no trauma, ok. The known-gout path does not require absence of trauma.
Missing 'short history' and 'single joint'; not distinguished from chronic arthritis/gout which share warm, swollen, painful joint.

rule_level_problems.rule: Diagnose probable gonococcal arthritis / sprain / chronic arthritis
rule_level_problems.problem: Flowchart rules (outside the red box, in scope as diagnostic logic). Sprain: 'recent injury' encoded as any Traumatic injury with no time bound, so old injury triggers sprain; fine as approximation. Gonococcal: 'recent' genital discharge or rash has no time bound; sprain/chronic criteria use the 'joint warm/tender/swollen' list but 'unable to do all actions comfortably' (limitation) is covered by Limitation of joint movement. Chronic arthritis and gonococcal share the same inputs but onset direction is correct per briefing convention (>= at least 6 weeks; <= within 6 weeks).

check_for items 'Surgery/injection into joint' missing; Eruption painless/Itching included. All other items used by some rule. SNOMED concept validity (e.g. Chronic arthritis, Joint warm, Unable to weight-bear, Wound as disorder) was not verified: the tools/snomed call failed on my invocation, so concept choice is unchecked.

summary: Red-box logic is largely encoded, but the 'no surgery or injection into joint' exclusion for acute gout is missing and septic arthritis lacks the 'short history, single joint' constraints. The Urgent priority rule is gated on Pain of joint although the page says any joint symptom. SNOMED concept validity was not verified because the snomed tool errored on my calls.
